name: plugin.openclaw_tool_repair
description: In-flight stream normalization and plain-text tool-call recovery engine for repairing malformed LLM tool invocations.

entrypoints.name: openclaw_parse_tool_blocks
entrypoints.description: Parses plain-text tool call codeblocks, JSON fences, or XML-wrapped calls from raw LLM output.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Raw text output from LLM to inspect for embedded tool call blocks

entrypoints.name: openclaw_repair_tool_call
entrypoints.description: Repairs malformed tool call JSON payloads (trailing commas, unescaped characters, unclosed brackets).

parameters.name: raw_call
parameters.description: Malformed JSON tool call payload string

parameters.name: tool_name
parameters.description: Optional fallback tool name if not embedded in JSON

entrypoints.name: openclaw_normalize_stream_chunk
entrypoints.description: Processes a streaming chunk, stripping plain-text tool blocks from the visible stream and yielding promoted tool events.
